About these 3 rides

They ride on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. Every one with a posted start time rolls at 8:30 am. The group waits for everyone on 1 of them (no-drop). All 3 are road rides. They run 2 every week and 1 on dates posted one at a time. Each one was checked at its source on Oct 2, 2026.
